title: Olive and the Wind
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 57-sound stage (dr, fl, fr just added).

pages.illustration: Olive the owl sitting at the edge of a calm pond.
Leaves and ripples stirring as a strong wind picks up around the pond.
Olive looking up at the sky turning dark grey with clouds.
Olive the owl flying toward a hollow den in a nearby tree.
Olive the owl resting inside the cosy tree den.
Branches bending and leaves swirling outside the den in the strong wind.

pages.text: Olive is snug in the den.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl sitting dry and snug inside the den while wind rages outside.
The wind calming, branches outside the den settling still.

pages.text: Olive flaps back to the pond.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying back down to the calm pond.
